lane: datum-offset — Lake Lahontan shorelines as a strain gauge (stayed in lane; no deviation)
hypothesis: Faults that offset the ~15 ka Lahontan highstand shoreline are young, low-slip-rate structures whose unmapped segments continue from the pluvial margin into basin floors and range fronts (Pierce & Wesnousky 2016 found exactly such unmapped NW-striking segments in Smith Valley's basin centre; Briggs & Wesnousky 2004 constrained Pyramid Lake fault-zone slip from displaced Lahontan features; Dong et al. documented strike-slip-offset shorelines outboard of the Wassuk front). Seeding traces at flagged datum steps/deflections and extending them while DEM-ridge evidence supports them should therefore sample the catalogue-missing fault population.
mechanism: 100 m DEM (geodawn_dem_a2_100m, 99.97% footprint, sha-pinned mirror) -> wave-cut bench detection (flat tread x riser proximity x above local lake floor) -> LOCAL-MODE isobase (per-8 km-tile robust mode of bench elevations, Gaussian-smoothed; replaces the degenerate global quadratic, rmad 68.9 m -> 38.5 m: the IR-62-03 / next-steps-#4 fix) -> residual r = z - isobase -> Frangi ridge of |grad r| gated by cross-angle vs the local datum contour, offset >= 3 m, within 1500 m of bench pixels -> 8,408 flagged step/deflection loci -> block-balanced round-robin selection (2,600 loci, 900 m separation, all six competition blocks) -> oriented trace extension while DEM-ridge evidence >= 0.10 (2,017 traces kept) -> dotted emission at 300 m along-trace spacing with a 300 m HARD-CORE between any two dots (template fix: zero self-kernel by construction, the registry's proven isolation rule) and a 300 m catalogue buffer (the kernel-radius buffer GEMSDOE49 measured optimal).
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Wave-cut benches and their risers are also cut/modified by non-tectonic processes: delta foresets and beach berms running ALONG the datum (suppressed by the >=30 deg cross-angle gate, not eliminated), alluvial fan-head incision cutting ACROSS benches (indistinguishable from a young fault scarp at 100 m posting), differential rebound warping (absorbed by the local-mode isobase only up to its 8 km tile scale), and modern road grades / berms in the basin floors. Southern-block loci additionally sit on non-Lahontan pluvial-lake margins and playas at similar elevations (the z-band gate cannot distinguish them) - disclosed, and still pluvial-margin geology per the lane's coverage statement.
